messages:
Alyssa Chen: Heads up 10: prepping the renewal deck for BluePeak. They asked for uptime history, latency p95 trend, and how credits would be calculated if needed. @Raj can you pull a 30d snapshot? @Emma can you confirm if the p95 bump was infra or a rollout? Need a customer-friendly one-pager by EOD tomorrow.

Raj Patel: Pulling now. Quick headliner: 30d uptime 99.978%, p50 ~65ms, p95 ~235ms. Theres a notable tail on 2026-02-11 03:22 UTC. Ill paste CSV excerpt and link.

Emma Rivera: That date lines up with a canary model rollout. Root cause: KV-cache warmup causing higher token latencies on particular request paths. We reverted the canary and primed caches; no outage.

Mike O'Neill: Contract SLOs: monthly uptime 99.95%, p95 latency target 220ms. Credit policy triggers at >2% of minutes above latency threshold during billing period. BluePeak had ~1.8% of minutes over threshold, so not an automatic credit. I'll confirm with legal.

Olivia Park: From renewal enablement: they want RCA + mitigations before signing. We should include an internal action list and a short customer note.

Alyssa Chen: Action items: (1) Raj 10: add raw CSV + tiny chart link, (2) Emma 10: 2-3 sentence RCA for the customer slide, (3) Mike 10: legal confirmation on credits + recommendation on goodwill credit, (4) Olivia 10: I will draft the customer one-pager and mark any concessions as optional. Meeting Friday 10:00 PT.

Raj Patel: CSV excerpt & chart: https://redwood.internal/metrics/bluepeak/1998765432
CSV snippet:
```
time,p50_ms,p95_ms,uptime_percent
2026-02-01,60,180,100
2026-02-11,62,240,99.997
2026-02-12,61,200,99.999
2026-02-28,64,220,99.99
```
Full export uploaded to shared drive.

Emma Rivera: RCA copy for deck:
"On 2026-02-11 we observed an elevated p95 latency during a canary model rollout. Root cause: cache warmup and increased KV-cache misses for a subset of request paths. Immediate mitigation: rollback and cache priming. Permanent mitigations: staged rollout with warmup traffic, automated tail-latency checks, and a cache-warmup job. Patch deployed 2026-02-13."

Mike O'Neill: Legal confirms threshold is >2% to trigger mandatory credit. BluePeak was ~1.8% so not eligible. My recommendation: offer a 5% goodwill invoice credit for one month as a negotiation concession, mark as optional in the deck.

Olivia Park: +1 on optional 5% credit. Use as de-risking lever, do not present as automatic entitlement.

Alyssa Chen: Thanks team 10: Ill post the draft one-pager and internal action queue here by EOD. Meeting invite sent for Fri 10:00 PT. Anyone add anything, drop it below.

calendar-bot: Meeting scheduled: BluePeak SLA review 10: Friday 10:00 AM PT (invite sent).
